name: ToolHop
description: ToolHop is a dataset designed to rigorously evaluate large language models' capabilities in multi-hop tool use through 995 user queries and 3,912 associated tools. It focuses on diverse queries with meaningful interdependencies and verifiable answers, enabling assessment of understanding, reasoning, and function-calling abilities.
reputation: A newly introduced tool-use benchmark that is gaining attention for multi-hop function-calling evaluation, but is not yet broadly established.
notes: Includes 995 queries and 3,912 tools; evaluates 14 LLMs across five families; best model achieves 49.04% accuracy; dataset and code available on Hugging Face.
